Internet Society India Mumbai Chapter × YourSpace Workshop Concluded · 30 May 2026
Workshop Impact Report

Chronically Online

A 75-minute live workshop on digital fatigue & burnout, held on Zoom, designed and delivered with YourSpace, attended by a global community of researchers, professionals and students.

🗓 Sat 30 May 2026 🕖 7:00 PM IST 🎙 Live on Zoom ⏱ 75 minutes total
Before the event

The invitation

The message that travelled through WhatsApp groups, LinkedIn posts, mailing lists, and personal networks, helping the workshop reach participants across India.

Invitation message

Are we actually resting, or just scrolling?

Most of us spend hours online every day — checking notifications, replying to messages, watching reels, doomscrolling, switching between tabs — and calling it “a break”. But why do we still feel exhausted?

Internet Society India Mumbai Chapter, in collaboration with YourSpace, invites you to:

Chronically Online: A Workshop on Digital Fatigue & Burnout

This is a free, live, interactive Zoom workshop on digital fatigue, doomscrolling, “fake rest”, overstimulation, burnout, and the pressure to always be available. Expect conversations, small activities, and honest reflection — not a lecture.

If your screen-time report has been personally attacking you, this session is for you.

Sign-ups and turnout

How the community showed up

A look at how registrations translated into live attendance, and where engagement was strongest.

Turnout by participant group

Bar shows attended (filled) within registered (outlined)

Turnout by screen-time tier

Did heavier or lighter users attend more?

👥

Engagement was broadly even across audience groups. Professionals, students and others all attended in a comparable band, suggesting the topic landed across demographic lines rather than skewing to any one cohort.

📈

Screen time had no measurable bearing on attendance. Every tier from "under 2 hours" to "8+ hours" converted within a narrow band. Whatever drew people in, it wasn't how online they already were.

The Session

How the 75 minutes unfolded

The workshop was structured as four interactive "rounds," each followed by a guided reflection. The format borrowed video-game language (checkpoints, levels, players) to disarm a heavy topic.

From the room

Inside the workshop

Moments from the live Zoom session: moderators, speakers, and the community that joined from 28 Indian states and 18 countries.

Voices

Speakers & moderator

The session was moderated by ISOC Mumbai and led through the four rounds by the YourSpace team, a peer-led conversation rather than a top-down lecture.

Behind the workshop

The organisers

Internet Society India Mumbai Chapter

The Mumbai chapter of the Internet Society, a global nonprofit working to make the internet open, globally connected, secure and trustworthy. The chapter convenes researchers, policy voices, technologists and students around questions of digital governance, access and wellbeing.

internetsociety.org ↗

YourSpace

A mental health collective focused on creating accessible, peer-led spaces for emotional reflection. YourSpace designed and led the workshop's four-round format, bringing a counsellor-informed perspective to the conversation about digital wellbeing.
